# S66 — Investigate intermittent API 26 typedTrackerNameSurvivesRecreation failure

**Findings:** S22 on API 26 (s08_api26): NavigationTest.typedTrackerNameSurvivesRecreation failed 2 of 10 full-suite runs; the Name field was empty after recreate(). Unlike editingTrackerNameSurvivesRecreation, the test does not assert the typed text before recreate(), so a test race is possible; lost user input is not ruled out. Owner: investigate the app first. · **Size:** S · **Tree:** release

**2026-10-05** — Investigated the app first, as the owner asked. On API 26 (s08_api26, debug build of main 9b1f320, idle host) I typed into the create dialog's Name field, recreated the activity and read the field back:
- 10 recreations by rotation and 10 by font-scale configuration change, each after the typed text was read back: Name kept 'Unfinished' 20/20.
- The same 20 again with no wait between typing and recreation: 20/20 kept.

No lost input was reproduced in 40 tries. Limit: adb adds latency, so this cannot match the test's in-process timing exactly, and a very narrow race is not ruled out.

Change (test only): typedTrackerNameSurvivesRecreation now asserts the typed text before recreate(), like editingTrackerNameSurvivesRecreation.

Results:
- API 26: 10 consecutive full-suite runs via am instrument, all OK (56 tests). Before the fix the rate was 2 failures in 10 runs, so 10 clean runs would happen about 11% of the time with no improvement. This is strong but not conclusive.
- API 36: OK (56 tests).
